lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to warn Pharaoh that He will plague Egypt with frogs if Pharaoh refuses to let His people go.
Aaron stretches out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs cover the land.
Pharaoh asks Moses to pray for the frogs to go, and Moses agrees to do it at sunset.
Moses cries out to the LORD, and the frogs die, but Pharaoh softens his heart when he sees relief.
Aaron strikes the dust and it becomes gnats, the magicians cannot copy it, and they say it is the finger of God.
